set.body:
From the ADR 0026 re-review (65bdf11ba), two follow-ups on ContestationSet (document/promotion.scala):
(1) Rule 3: ContestationSet.of does not check that a record's upstream claim ids exist in model.claims or that its anchors are checkedOn(model.bundle). This fails closed (a forged record can only block a promotion), but the citation should be checked against the model.
(2) Rule 13: the set records no producer provenance, so an empty set from the recall-blind source build cannot be told apart from one any caller built. Attach a build receipt, or the provenance of the S3c/S3d source build, to the set and to its digest.

Acceptance: a record citing an unknown upstream claim is refused by a named test; the set's digest changes with its producer receipt.
set.title: [evidence-binding] ContestationSet: check citations against the model; record producer provenance
